clips.title: The story
paras: At Silverwind Refuge, Sentinel Velene Starstrike gives investigators the Divining Scroll to trace the corrupted elementals to their creator.

Corrupt water elementals rise from Ashenvale’s pools, and the Sentinels know the disturbance is unnatural. Sentinel Velene Starstrike obtains a scroll to find who is responsible. With intact elemental bracers as a focus, its magic draws out the summoner’s signature. The blank parchment becomes a Divined Scroll and names the guilty party.
